verdict.rationale: Aider covers the code-change middle of this workflow. It infers which files to edit from a request, applies edits, auto-commits with descriptive messages, and can lint and auto-test. It can also be scripted non-interactively via `--message` or the Python API, which one user describes wiring into a pipeline where PRs get created. There is no first-party evidence of reading issues from a tracker or opening a pull request, so the end-to-end flow needs external glue. Missing for 10: issue-tracker ingestion, pull-request creation/push to a forge, a documented end-to-end issue-to-PR workflow, independent hands-on corroboration of the full flow.
